scenarios.title: Empty / whitespace-only filter degrades sensibly
scenarios.purpose: Confirm an empty or whitespace-only filter does not crash and does not present a bare blank screen.
scenarios.rationale: Empty-query is the most common boundary a search box hits; it must resolve to either the full list or an explicit prompt, never a blank or an error.
scenarios.requirement_reference: a filter with no matches says so rather than showing nothing
expected_observations: A whitespace-only query renders either the shipment list or an explicit prompt/empty-state — the word 'shipment' appears in view chrome.
forbidden_observations: A completely blank page for an empty query.

scenarios.title: Concurrent searches stay consistent and write nothing
scenarios.purpose: Confirm simultaneous searches return correct results and do not trigger any write under concurrent read load.
scenarios.rationale: A read view hit concurrently must not lazily materialize/cache into a mutation table; a race is the classic way a 'read-only' path sneaks a write.
scenarios.requirement_reference: the view performs no write of any kind
expected_observations: effect_grants count query succeeds and (compared to S-RO3-03 baseline) shows no growth attributable to the reads.
forbidden_observations: A request errors or times out under concurrent load.
effect_grants grew during the concurrent read burst.

assumptions: The read-only view is served by the same app at http://127.0.0.1:8001 and is reachable at /shipments, accepting a reference/filter via a `q` query parameter. The exact route and parameter name are unknown because U-RO-3 is unimplemented; browser/request paths must be re-pointed once the real route exists.
The 'no matches' empty-state renders literal text containing 'no matching'; the exact wording must be confirmed against the implementation.

Reference '101' identifies a shipment present in the driver_probe workspace (it is used pervasively across existing tests); if that workspace's data differs, S-RO3-01 must be re-seeded with a real reference.
The app writes to data/active_workspace/driver_probe/workflow.sqlite3, so counts read there reflect any write the view would make.
Mutation-bearing tables are effect_grants, operation_action_claims, delivery_action_claims, operation_token_amounts, audit_events (from CANONICAL_TENANT_TABLES); the no-write assertions target these.
unresolved_questions: What is the actual route and query-parameter contract for the new view (path, method, filter field names)? All functional scenarios assume /shipments?q=... and must be corrected once known.
What exact text does the empty-state show when a filter matches nothing? AC2 requires it 'says so', but the specific string is unspecified.

Is there a fixture that seeds shipments for more than one tenant in the driver_probe workspace? Without one, the cross-tenant leak scenario (S-RO3-06) cannot be executed and tenant scoping of the view cannot be verified.

Does 'reference' mean the load id, the pro/PRO number, or both, and is matching exact or substring/case-insensitive? This determines the correct happy-path inputs and whether partial-match boundary cases exist.
Is any read-audit logging intended for the view? If a read is meant to append to audit_events, the no-write assertion on audit_events (S-RO3-03) must be relaxed for that table only.

raw.title: A battery of searches writes nothing to the mutation tables
raw.purpose: Prove the read-only guarantee: after matching, non-matching, and repeated searches, the effect/claim/audit tables are unchanged.
raw.requirement_reference: the view performs no write of any kind
raw.rationale: Weight-3 AC; an HTTP 200 is not evidence of no-write, so persisted mutation-table counts must be captured before and after and compared for equality.
setup: Baseline is captured immediately before issuing any search request against the same probe workspace DB the app writes to.

state_check.command: sqlite3 data/active_workspace/driver_probe/workflow.sqlite3 "SELECT 'eg='||count(*) FROM effect_grants UNION ALL SELECT 'oac='||count(*) FROM operation_action_claims UNION ALL SELECT 'dac='||count(*) FROM delivery_action_claims UNION ALL SELECT 'ota='||count(*) FROM operation_token_amounts UNION ALL SELECT 'audit='||count(*) FROM audit_events"

sqlite3 data/active_workspace/driver_probe/workflow.sqlite3 "SELECT 'eg='||count(*) FROM effect_grants UNION ALL SELECT 'oac='||count(*) FROM operation_action_claims UNION ALL SELECT 'dac='||count(*) FROM delivery_action_claims UNION ALL SELECT 'ota='||count(*) FROM operation_token_amounts UNION ALL SELECT 'audit='||count(*) FROM audit_events"

persisted_state_checks.assertion: count identical in the before and after state_check outputs
count identical before and after — no read is logged as a mutating event

expected_observations: The five labelled counts (eg=, oac=, dac=, ota=, audit=) are byte-for-byte identical between the pre-search and post-search state_check outputs.
forbidden_observations: Any of the mutation-table counts is higher after the searches than before.
raw.isolation_note: Verifies absence of writes; itself performs only reads, no cleanup needed.
